title: Optional tenantId on every tenant-owned model (additive)
description:
Outcome: Add tenantId: a.string() (optional) to the 50 tenant-owned models that lack it: UserRoleAssignment (superseded by TenantMembership, kept for dedicated), Assignment, AssignmentEvent, ProcedureDefinition, ProcedureVersion, ProcedureRun, Automation, ReviewRequest, ReviewReadMark, StoryVariation, ReviewRecipientRule, KnowledgeCorpus, KnowledgeImportRun, KnowledgeRawPayload, CurationDelegationRecord, KnowledgeArtifact, CategorySet, Category, CategoryKeyword, LexicalSteeringRule, SteeringProposal, SteeringDecision, Reference, ReferenceAttachment, SemanticNode, Message, MessageThread, ModelAttachment, SemanticRelationType, SemanticRelation, Tag, ItemTag, Edition, EditionItem, PublishedEdition, PublishedEditionItem, PublishedCategorySet, PublishedCategory, EditorialPolicy, EditorialCheckSettings, EditorialFeedback, EditorialCheckRun, Proposal, ReaderProfile, ReaderHandle, ReaderVote, ReaderFlag, ReaderComment, ReaderSubmission, ReaderReport, ModerationAction, SignupEntry. Global identity models stay global: UserProfile, UserIdentity, PublicHandleClaim. Writers start stamping tenantId when they have one; nothing reads it yet.

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): amplify/data/schema.ts, amplify/functions/editorial-checks/schema.ts, amplify/functions/proposal-actions/schema.ts, amplify/plugins/reader-steering/schema.ts, amplify/plugins/signup/schema.ts, amplify/data/resource.ts (the twin definitions), scripts/test-schema-parity.ts, src/papyrus_content tenancy helpers (papyrus_content.tenancy).

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features_backend/tenant-field-everywhere.feature):
Scenario: A tenant client stamps its tenant on every write
    Given a client for tenant "alpha"
    When it creates a Message, an Assignment and a Reference
    Then each row has tenantId "alpha"

Scenario: A client without a tenant writes exactly as before
    Given a dedicated backend with no tenant configured
    When an editor creates a Message
    Then the row has no tenantId and the call succeeds

Dependencies: blocked by PPY-cd5926. Blocks PPY-06ae68, PPY-7dc463, PPY-ce6207, PPY-752480, PPY-f60a1e, PPY-ef2c57, PPY-1ce06f. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: PPY-e277e3.

Testing: Schema parity test; pytest for the tenant client stamping; Behave in a sandbox.
Rollout: One release for every site (adding a non-key attribute changes no table). Cost: none until rows are written.
Risk and mitigation: Risk: the Amplify CloudFormation resource count for a fresh create grows. Mitigation: no new resources (attributes only).

Releasable on its own: yes.
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: unchanged.
Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR on branch docs/multi-tenant-architecture).
